note: Illinois DNR state historic site at Ellis Grove: the earthwork remains of a French fort and a bluff-top overlook of the Mississippi and Kaskaskia Island. The campground is in woods back from the overlook; pit privies. A footpath leads down the bluff to the Pierre Menard Home. --Claude
summary: Historic-site page (dnrhistoric), ExploreMoreIL engine (all 45 units) and the 2027 fee PDF read: 36 Class B-E 30 A units (site page says 32), no water/sewer at sites, 21 web-bookable and the rest walk-in; lengths 18-40 ft, 32 take 23 ft+; $28 Electric 2027 (page/engine still $18, 2026); pit privies; booking operator -> usedirect, fcfs some_sites. FEES: stored $28 already reflected the 2027 Electric class; the historic site's page and the engine still show 2026's $18 electric / $8 non-electric. Fort Kaskaskia is a historic site, but its units use the state-park classes (B-E, C) and the engine prices them on the 2026 park schedule, so the 2027 schedule is applied. Per-entry $10 reservation fee removed (state:IL row).
SITE COUNT: engine 36 Class B-E units vs the historic-site page's 'thirty-two electrified sites'; 36 written with a note.

SITE LENGTH: engine lengths vary by site (18, 22, 25, 30, 38, 40), so they look like real values rather than the IDNR 40-ft default; 32 of 36 electric sites take 23 ft+ (001/002 18 ft, 003/004 22 ft).

SEASON: none stored, none written. The grounds are 'open year-round from 7 AM to 10 PM' (day use) and the engine shows every date in season through 2028-01-05 (the reservation season); no statement about the campground closing.
PHONE: 618-859-3741 confirmed (historic site page). No change.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept; the campground is on the wooded bluff top, the Mississippi ~0.5 km away below the bluff beyond the rail line.
